edges.reason: msg.sender is supplied as the sender argument when transfer() delegates to _transfer.
msg.sender is the recipient of the initial mint in the BurnableERC20 constructor.
The caller-supplied msg.value is forwarded to the external pay call.
transfer() invokes the internal _transfer routine.
transferFrom() invokes the internal _transfer routine.
The recipient parameter flows into _transfer.
The amount parameter flows into _transfer.
_balances[sender] is read into the senderBalance local variable.
senderBalance is the left operand of the balance-debit subtraction.
The subtraction result is written back into _balances[sender].
_transfer executes the balance credit for the recipient.
Credited balance is stored in the _balances mapping.
_allowances[sender][msg.sender] is read into currentAllowance.
currentAllowance is the left operand of the allowance decrement.
The decremented allowance is written back to _allowances.
The spender parameter flows into _approve.
_approve performs an unconditional allowance overwrite.
The overwritten allowance value is stored in the _allowances mapping.
The BurnableERC20 constructor calls _mint for the initial supply.
initialBalance_ is the amount minted by the constructor.
_mint executes the total supply increase.
The increased supply is stored in _totalSupply.
_burn executes the total supply decrease.
The decreased supply is stored in _totalSupply.
burn() invokes the internal _burn routine.
burnFrom() invokes the internal _burn routine after adjusting allowance.
transferFrom() calls _approve to reduce the spender allowance.
increaseAllowance() reaches the allowance overwrite via _approve.
decreaseAllowance() reuses the same allowance subtraction pattern.
The account parameter flows into _burn.
feeReceiver_ is the recipient of the external pay call.
The external payable pay call runs before the constructor mint, so a malicious fee receiver can reenter while supply state is still uninitialised.
decimals_ parameter is stored into the immutable _decimals slot.
